key_decisions.decision: Keeps plural dwellings and title attribution.
Preserves bird/maternal nest imagery and altar proximity without asserting nests on burning altars.
Makes the contextual destination of heart-highways readable while noting the compressed Hebrew.
Keeps Baca untranslated, rain and blessings, with alternative meanings noted.
Preserves progressive strength and the individual appearance within the group.
Reads shield parallel to anointed ruler, with the divine-shield alternative noted.
Retains exact thousand and threshold without inventing an official doorkeeper position.
